svg.title: Twenty-eight algorithms, eight domains
svg.desc: Eight domain tiles draw on in turn, from cryptography to Fourier methods, and each gets a citation mark. Steps: 1. 28 visualizations across 8 domains. 2. Each one runs on inputs you supply. 3. Every step of every trace names its source. Sources: Algorithm Visualizer README.

text.tspan: Each one runs on inputs you supply.
Every step of every trace names its source.
Eight domain tiles draw on in turn, from cryptography to Fourier methods, and each gets a citation mark.
